messages:
Lena (Collections): Apex Bio (acct AB-957) flagged invoice 2026-05-28 for $29,140 as overdue. Customer claims they were double-billed for a large batch run and asked for an immediate credit + a 90-day payoff plan.
Ivy (Acct Exec): They dropped a support ticket with logs showing duplicate job ids. Looks legit but CS needs to validate.
Marco (Finance): For ~29k we can consider a partial credit after verification. Don't commit to 90 days without a signed agreement. Suggest 40% credit contingent on CS confirmation, 30% paid now, remainder split over 45 days.
Samir (Legal): We should avoid promising credits in-thread. Approve conditional wording: "subject to verification of duplicate usage by CS and signed agreement". Also include clause: "failure to make agreed payments may result in temporary suspension of service and referral to collections."
Lena (Collections): Draft reply to customer below, please quick review: ```Hi Apex team, thanks for raising this. We received your dispute about duplicate charges on invoice 2026-05-28. We will validate the jobs with CS; if duplicates are confirmed we can issue a one-time credit up to 40% of the invoice amount. To move forward we require: (1) signed payment agreement, (2) 30% payment within 5 business days, (3) remaining balance split over 45 days. This offer is contingent on CS verification of duplicate job ids. Missed payments incur a 1.5% monthly finance charge and may result in temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys. Please reply with acceptance and attach any supporting logs. -- Lena, Redwood Billing```
Marco (Finance): That looks fine. Add CC to billing@redwood and require payment trace to release any holds.
Ivy (Acct Exec): I'll run CS verification now and attach the job CSV in a follow up.
billing-bot: Recorded: account AB-957 | invoice 2026-05-28 | balance $29,140 | dispute-acknowledged | follow-up 1801006200.
Samir (Legal): OK to send with edits. Keep the credit capped at 40% and mark as one-time concession in the message.
Lena (Collections): Sending now with the edits and CCs. If no reply by follow-up we'll start formal dunning.
